title: Can AI Mediation Improve Democratic Deliberation?

bias_targets.methodology: Using embedding analysis to quantify the influence and proportional representation of majority and minority opinions in the generated group statements, and analyzing the potential for unfair impacts of these statements on participants' belief changes.
Evaluating the risk of personalized reward models (PRMs) misinterpreting or providing less accurate preference predictions for participants who communicate in non-standard English or other languages.
Assessing the AI mediator's performance and accuracy across different demographic subgroups by comparing outcomes from convenience samples with those from demographically representative samples.
